candidates.test_objective: Verify that a positive constant speed reference produces positive steady-state motor speed.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the non-zero positive reference for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive, matching the sign of the positive SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the positive non-zero reference partition for bidirectional control.

candidates.test_objective: Verify that a negative constant speed reference produces negative steady-state motor speed.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the non-zero negative reference for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative, matching the sign of the negative SpeedRef.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the negative non-zero reference partition for bidirectional control.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive-direction control at a moderate positive speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the reference for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive.
candidates.rationale: Provides a distinct positive-direction operating scenario within the nominal domain.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative-direction control at a moderate negative speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the reference for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative.
candidates.rationale: Provides a distinct negative-direction operating scenario within the nominal domain.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive direction near the upper nominal reference boundary.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the reference for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a positive reference just inside the stated nominal domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative direction near the lower nominal reference boundary.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the reference for the simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a negative reference just inside the stated nominal domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a small positive constant reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain SpeedRef at 2 rps and ensure persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant 2 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises nominal constant tracking in the positive direction without adding a numerical error criterion.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a small negative constant reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain SpeedRef at -2 rps and ensure persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant -2 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises nominal constant tracking in the negative direction.

candidates.test_objective: Verify constant tracking at a midrange positive reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain SpeedRef at 8 rps and ensure persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant 8 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Covers a distinct midrange positive constant-reference partition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify constant tracking at a midrange negative reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain SpeedRef at -8 rps and ensure persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant -8 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Covers a distinct midrange negative constant-reference partition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify tracking near the positive edge of the nominal reference domain.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain SpeedRef at 19.5 rps and ensure persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant 19.5 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises constant tracking close to, but strictly within, the positive nominal-domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify tracking near the negative edge of the nominal reference domain.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain SpeedRef at -19.5 rps and ensure persistent actuator saturation does not occur.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant -19.5 rps reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises constant tracking close to, but strictly within, the negative nominal-domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Assess voltage-limited behavior while applying a positive reference beyond the nominal domain.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; apply the reference for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: Vcmd remains within -12 V to +12 V throughout the simulation interval; tracking convergence is not asserted because persistent actuator saturation may occur.
candidates.rationale: Uses the first value at the stated nominal-domain boundary to expose the tracking precondition without inventing a tracking threshold.

candidates.test_objective: Verify the voltage command remains limited for a small positive reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the reference for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the simulation interval remain within +12 V and -12 V, respectively.
candidates.rationale: Checks voltage limitation for a nominal positive command condition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify the voltage command remains limited for a small negative reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the reference for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the simulation interval remain within +12 V and -12 V, respectively.
candidates.rationale: Checks voltage limitation for a nominal negative command condition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify voltage limitation during a positive-to-negative reference reversal.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller at rest, establish steady operation with the first reference, then apply the second reference and simulate the complete sequence.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the complete reversal simulation remain within +12 V and -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Checks the voltage requirement during a directional transition in both command polarities.

candidates.test_objective: Verify voltage limitation during a negative-to-positive reference reversal.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller at rest, establish steady operation with the first reference, then apply the second reference and simulate the complete sequence.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the complete reversal simulation remain within +12 V and -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Complements the opposite reversal direction while observing Vcmd over the full sequence.

candidates.test_objective: Verify voltage limitation at a high positive nominal reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the reference for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the simulation interval remain within +12 V and -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Exercises voltage limitation near the positive nominal reference boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify voltage limitation at a high negative nominal reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; maintain the reference for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the simulation interval remain within +12 V and -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Exercises voltage limitation near the negative nominal reference boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify voltage limitation for a large positive stress reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; apply the stress reference for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the simulation interval remain within +12 V and -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Provides a stress stimulus outside the stated nominal SpeedRef domain while retaining the explicit voltage-limit criterion.

candidates.test_objective: Verify voltage limitation for a large negative stress reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the controller and plant at rest; apply the stress reference for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the simulation interval remain within +12 V and -12 V.
candidates.rationale: Complements the positive stress case with the opposite command polarity.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable reversal from positive to negative speed.
candidates.precondition: Initialize at rest, maintain +5 rps until steady operation, then change SpeedRef to -5 rps and continue simulation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from the original positive direction to the negative reference direction and converges stably to the new reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Directly exercises the positive-to-negative transition required by the reversal requirement.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable reversal from negative to positive speed.
candidates.precondition: Initialize at rest, maintain -5 rps until steady operation, then change SpeedRef to +5 rps and continue simulation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from the original negative direction to the positive reference direction and converges stably to the new reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Directly exercises the negative-to-positive transition required by the reversal requirement.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal between larger positive and negative nominal references.
candidates.precondition: Initialize at rest, establish steady operation at +15 rps, then change SpeedRef to -15 rps and continue simulation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from positive to negative and converges stably to the new negative reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a larger-amplitude positive-to-negative reversal while keeping both values strictly within the nominal domain.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal between larger negative and positive nominal references.
candidates.precondition: Initialize at rest, establish steady operation at -15 rps, then change SpeedRef to +15 rps and continue simulation.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from negative to positive and converges stably to the new positive reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Complements the opposite larger-amplitude reversal direction within the nominal domain.
